## Problem and expected behavior

Describe the operation, what happened, and what you expected.

## Steps to reproduce

Use disposable files or a minimal fixture. Do not attach personal knowledge, saved inputs, profiles, paths, emails or credentials.

## Environment

- Mogledge version and installation/build method:
- OS, architecture and WebView version when relevant:
- Language, display scale and keyboard/IME when relevant:

## Evidence and limits

Attach only redacted screenshots or necessary error text. Distinguish verified facts from guesses and note whether the issue is repeatable. For developers, include the tested source revision if known.
